# Mussawar Hayat — Full-Stack & Web3 Developer

> Mussawar Hayat is a full-stack developer specializing in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and Web3. Based in Attock, Punjab, Pakistan. Available for remote freelance work with clients in North America and Europe. 3+ years shipping production SaaS platforms, DApps, Solidity smart contracts, mobile apps (React Native / Flutter), and end-to-end infrastructure (Nginx, PM2, Docker, GitHub Actions, SPF/DKIM/DMARC).

Mussawar Hayat owns projects end-to-end: frontend, backend, database, DevOps, and blockchain when required. He is the primary engineer for clients who want one accountable owner instead of a multi-vendor stack.
